```{r}
reference_scenario = ""
load("1476.RData")

# Create scenarios object for new plots
scenarios <- output
agg_scenario <- output_ag

figure_folder <- function(x){
  path = file.path(getwd(),'Plots',
                   x)
  print(path)
  return(path)
}


scen_pub_names_new <- scen_pub_names |>
  mutate(PUBSCEN = case_when(
    PUBSCEN == "Diet -10 NonFed 0 Capture -10" ~ "Barriers to Blue Growth",
    PUBSCEN == "Diet 0 NonFed 0 Capture 0" ~ "BAU",
    PUBSCEN == "Diet +10 NonFed +50 Capture +10" ~ "Blue Transformation",
    PUBSCEN == is.na(PUBSCEN) ~ "FAO",
    TRUE ~ as.character(PUBSCEN)
  ))

raw_scen_names <- c("SCEN_DIET-10_CULTURE0_CAPTURE-10","SCEN_DIET0_CULTURE0_CAPTURE0","SCEN_DIET+10_CULTURE+50_CAPTURE+10")
scen_include <- function(x){
  x %>% filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% raw_scen_names)
}

production_df_detailed <- output_ag_2020 %>% filter(VAR_ID == 'PROD',ITEM_AG %in% c('CRP','LSP',VAR_UNIT == '1000 T')) %>% 
  group_by(ITEM_AG,ALLSCEN3,YEAR) %>% 
  summarise(output = sum(OUTPUT_AG)) %>% 
  rename('TYPE' = 'ITEM_AG') %>% 
  bind_rows(
    fish_var_2020  %>% #  filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% c("SCEN_BAU", "SCEN_DIET_+05"#, "SCEN_CAP_WILD"           )) %>% 
      mutate(Inland = ifelse(as.numeric(FISHREG) < 10 | FISHSYST == "AQUA_F","Inland","Marine") ) %>% ################ FFFFIIIIXXX THIS
      mutate(GROUP = case_when(FISHSPEC %in% c("DMRS","MARN","SALM","TUNA","FRSH","PELG") ~ "Finfish",
                               FISHSPEC %in% c("SHRI","CRST") ~ "Crustaceans",
                               FISHSPEC %in% c("MLSC","CEPH") ~ "Molluscs"),
             TYPE = ifelse(FISHSYST == 'CATCH',"CATCH","CULTURE")) %>%
      group_by(ALLSCEN3, #TYPE, 
               TYPE,FISHFEEDSYST, #Inland,
               YEAR#, GROUP
      ) %>% {products <<- .}  %>% 
      summarise(output = sum(FISH_VAR_COMPARE)) 
  )
```

```{r Figure 1: Demand}
live_final <- c("BVMEAT","SGMEAT","PGMEAT","PTMEAT","ALMILK","PTEGGS")
  # tidy_globiom("DemQuantity_Compare") %>% 
DData %>%
  scen_include %>%
  filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    product_type = case_when(
      PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
      PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
  mutate(ITEMw = ifelse(is.na(ITEMw), 1, ITEMw)) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
    product_type == "Fish" ~ DDATA_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
    TRUE ~ DDATA_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
  )) %>%
  group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
  filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
  summarise(DData = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_longer(DData) %>%
  bind_rows(
    DemQuantity %>%
      scen_include %>%
      filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
      mutate(
        product_type = case_when(
          PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
          PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
      mutate(value = case_when(
        product_type == "Fish" ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
        TRUE ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
      )) %>%
      group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
      # filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
      summarise(DemQ = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
      pivot_longer(DemQ)
  ) %>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>%
  # mutate(PUBSCEN = factor(PUBSCEN, levels = pub_levels)) %>%
  filter(name == 'DemQ') %>%
  # left_join(fish_pub_names) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = value / 1000, col = PUBSCEN, group = PUBSCEN)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # geom_text(aes(label = dem/1000)) +
  ylab("Global Demand (MT)") +
  xlab("Year") +
  # ylim(0,100)+
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~product_type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4)[-1] %>% rev(),
    name = "Scenario"
  )
ggsave(figure_folder('1_demand_lineplot.png'), width = 6, height = 4, unit = 'in')
```

```{Demand per Capita}
# Get global population data for ALL scenarios
global_pop <- output %>%
  filter(VAR_ID == "POPT") %>%
  group_by(YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%  # Group by scenario too
  summarise(total_pop = sum(OUTPUT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Calculate per capita demand
DData %>%
  scen_include %>%
  filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    product_type = case_when(
      PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
      PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
  mutate(ITEMw = ifelse(is.na(ITEMw), 1, ITEMw)) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
    product_type == "Fish" ~ DDATA_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
    TRUE ~ DDATA_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
  )) %>%
  group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
  filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
  summarise(DData = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Add debugging: uncomment to see actual totals BY SCENARIO
  # filter(YEAR == 2030, ALLSCEN3 == "SCEN_DIET-10_CULTURE0_CAPTURE-10") %>% print() %>%
  pivot_longer(DData) %>%
  bind_rows(
    DemQuantity %>%
      scen_include %>%
      filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
      mutate(
        product_type = case_when(
          PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
          PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
      mutate(value = case_when(
        product_type == "Fish" ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
        TRUE ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
      )) %>%
      group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
      # filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
      summarise(DemQ = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
      pivot_longer(DemQ)
  ) %>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>%
  filter(name == 'DemQ') %>%
  # Join with population data to calculate per capita
  left_join(global_pop, by = c("YEAR", "ALLSCEN3")) %>%  # Join by both YEAR and ALLSCEN3
  # Add debugging output
mutate(per_capita_kg = (value / 1000 / total_pop) * 1000) %>% # Uncomment these lines to debug:
  #glimpse() %>%
  #filter(YEAR == 2030) %>% print() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = per_capita_kg, col = PUBSCEN, shape = product_type, group = interaction(PUBSCEN, product_type))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ylab("Per Capita Demand (kg/person)") +
  xlab("Year") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4)[-1] %>% rev(),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Fish" = 16, "Livestock" = 17),
    name = "Product Type"
  )
  ggsave(figure_folder('1_demand_percapita.png'), width = 6, height = 4, unit = 'in')
```

```{r Figure 2 Production Dynamics}
## Figure S1 Production Dynamics

# --- Load core FAO datasets from fishstat package ---
library(fishstat)
data("production") # Global aquaculture + capture quantities (1950–2023)
data("species") # Lookup for species groupings (incl. 'yearbook')
data("area") # Lookup for areas (incl. 'inlandmarine')

# --- Avoid name collisions: rename lookup tables ---
species_lu <- species
area_lu <- area

# --- Keep live-weight quantities (Q_tlw) and positive values ---
prod <- production %>%
  filter(measure == "Q_tlw", value > 0)

# --- Join lookups to add 'yearbook' (species grouping) and 'inlandmarine' (area type) ---
prod <- prod %>%
  left_join(species_lu %>% select(species, yearbook), by = "species") %>%
  left_join(area_lu %>% select(area, inlandmarine), by = "area")

# --- Filter to aquatic animals only (exclude algae, shells/pearls, mammals, reptiles) ---
prod_animals <- prod %>%
  filter(grepl("Fish, crustaceans and molluscs", yearbook, fixed = TRUE))

# --- Label origin (Capture vs Aquaculture) from 'source' field ---
prod_animals <- prod_animals %>%
  mutate(origin = ifelse(source == "CAPTURE", "Capture", "Aquaculture"))

# --- World totals per year by origin (million tonnes) ---
world_totals <- prod_animals %>%
  group_by(year, origin) %>%
  summarise(value_mt = sum(value) / 1e6, .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = origin, values_from = value_mt)

# --- Extract exact FAO values at decade marks ---
decades <- c(1950, 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)
fao_decades <- world_totals %>%
  filter(year %in% decades) %>%
  arrange(year)

# --- Transform to match expected format ---
data <- fao_decades %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Aquaculture, Capture), 
               names_to = 'origin_type', 
               values_to = 'output') %>%
  mutate(TYPE = ifelse(origin_type == "Capture", "CATCH", "CULTURE"),
         YEAR = as.character(year),
         output = output * 1000,  # Convert Mt to thousands of tonnes
         PUBSCEN = "FAO",
         Source = "FAO") %>%
  select(YEAR, TYPE, output, PUBSCEN, Source)


production_df <- production_df_ %>% 
  scen_include()

products <- products %>% 
    scen_include()

pub_levels = production_df %>% filter(TYPE == 'CULTURE',YEAR == max(production_df %>% pull(YEAR))) %>% 
  arrange(output) %>% pull(PUBSCEN) %>% rev()# filter(!(PUBSCEN %>% str_detect("Production"))) %>% 
  #  dplyr::select(-ALLSCEN3) %>% 
  # group_by(GROUP,FISHSYST, Inland, YEAR) %>%
  # summarise(output = sum(output)) %>%
  # filter(YEAR == 2020) %>%
  # # mutate(output = ifelse(FISHSYST == "CATCH",-1*output, output)) %>%
  # filter(TYPE %in% c("CULTURE","CATCH"), ALLSCEN3 != "SCEN_REF_2020") %>% 
  # mutate(Source = 'This Study') %>% 
  # bind_rows(data)

production_df %>% # filter(!(PUBSCEN %>% str_detect("Production"))) %>% 
  #  dplyr::select(-ALLSCEN3) %>% 
  # group_by(GROUP,FISHSYST, Inland, YEAR) %>%
  # summarise(output = sum(output)) %>%
  # filter(YEAR == 2020) %>%
  # mutate(output = ifelse(FISHSYST == "CATCH",-1*output, output)) %>%
  filter(TYPE %in% c("CULTURE","CATCH"), ALLSCEN3 != "SCEN_REF_2020") %>% 
  mutate(Source = 'This Study') %>% 
    filter(!is.na(PUBSCEN)) %>% 

  bind_rows(data) %>% 
  # mutate(PUBSCEN = factor(PUBSCEN, levels = pub_levels)) %>% 
  filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% raw_scen_names | is.na(ALLSCEN3)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-PUBSCEN)%>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>% 
  mutate(PUBSCEN = ifelse(is.na(PUBSCEN),"FAO",PUBSCEN)) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = YEAR,
                y = output/1000,
                linetype = Source,
                group = PUBSCEN,
                col = PUBSCEN
  )) +
  geom_point(aes(x = YEAR,
                 y = output/1000,
                # linetype = Source,
                 group =PUBSCEN,
                 col = PUBSCEN
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  #facet_grid(TYPE~Inland) +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  # scale_y_continuous(breaks = c((-4:4)*20)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4) %>% rev(),
                      name = 'Scenario') +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed", "solid")) +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  ylab('Production (Mt)') +
  xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~TYPE,ncol = 1,scales = 'free')
ggsave(figure_folder("1_production_lineplot.png"),width = 9, height = 6)
```

```{r Figure 3. Aquafeed Comparison}
  mutate(ALLSCEN3 = 'SCEN_REF_2020')

  summarise(value = sum(FISH_AQUAFEED_QUANTITY_COMPARE)) %>%
```

```{r Figure - Production by System Barplot}
# Create publication-ready system names mapping
system_names <- tibble(

  PUBSYST = c("Cattle", "Pig", "Poultry", "Capture (Freshwater)", "Capture (Marine)",

)

system_colors <- c(
  "Capture (Freshwater)" = "#66c2a5",

)

# Create production lineplot for patchwork
# Recreate FAO data from fishstat package
library(fishstat)
data("production")
data("species")
data("area")

# Process FAO data
fao_prod <- production %>%
  filter(measure == "Q_tlw", value > 0) %>%
  left_join(species %>% select(species, yearbook), by = "species") %>%
  left_join(area %>% select(area, inlandmarine), by = "area") %>%
  filter(grepl("Fish, crustaceans and molluscs", yearbook, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(origin = ifelse(source == "CAPTURE", "Capture", "Aquaculture"))

fao_totals <- fao_prod %>%
  group_by(year, origin) %>%
  summarise(value_mt = sum(value) / 1e6, .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = origin, values_from = value_mt)

fao_data <- fao_totals %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1950, 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Aquaculture, Capture), 
               names_to = 'origin_type', 
               values_to = 'output') %>%
  mutate(TYPE = ifelse(origin_type == "Capture", "CATCH", "CULTURE"),
         YEAR = as.character(year),
         output = output * 1000,
         PUBSCEN = "FAO",
         Source = "FAO") %>%
  select(YEAR, TYPE, output, PUBSCEN, Source)

prod_lineplot <- production_df %>% 
  filter(TYPE %in% c("CULTURE","CATCH"), ALLSCEN3 != "SCEN_REF_2020") %>% 
  mutate(Source = 'This Study') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(PUBSCEN)) %>% 
  bind_rows(fao_data) %>% 
  filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% raw_scen_names | is.na(ALLSCEN3)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-PUBSCEN) %>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>% 
  mutate(PUBSCEN = ifelse(is.na(PUBSCEN), "FAO", PUBSCEN)) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = YEAR, y = output/1000, linetype = Source, group = PUBSCEN, col = PUBSCEN)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = YEAR, y = output/1000, group = PUBSCEN, col = PUBSCEN)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_manual(values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4) %>% rev(), name = 'Scenario') +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed", "solid")) +
  labs(title = "b) Production Trends Over Time", y = 'Production (Mt)', x = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~TYPE, ncol = 1, scales = 'free') +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Combine plots
production_multi <- prod_system_barplot / prod_lineplot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.5)) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
  )

production_multi
ggsave(figure_folder("production_combined.png"), width = 10, height = 12, unit = 'in')
```
